findings.observation: A direct-linked quest at 390px follows an empty global questions panel. Quest title y754, optional unavailable Tutor y1088 through y1742, Approve spend y2474, Evidence y2628.

findings.observation: At 390px six persona filter cards occupy 804px and the actual run list begins at y1636.
findings.recommendation: Use compact mobile persona filters or a disclosure and prioritize active runs and errors. Preserve independent engine inspection and agent/preview handoffs.

findings.observation: The Usage voice modal separates a large portrait, status, provider-unavailable banner, introductory paragraphs, text form and recording footer from the assistant conversation.
findings.recommendation: Share one workspace conversation/composer for typed and spoken turns, compact capability states and explicit selected context. Text must remain usable when only speech is unavailable.

findings.observation: Normal route navigation focuses main and paints an orange outline around the entire page.
findings.recommendation: Retain skip-link/keyboard focus behavior while treating main as a navigation target rather than an interactive control.

findings.assessment: In dark Settings and onboarding, detailed caustics compete with long form labels and help text.
findings.recommendation: Use a quieter continuous material wash behind reading content and retain the integrated atmosphere in the surrounding canvas.
